# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide.csv")
data_long_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long_ml.csv")
data_wide_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide_ml.csv")
```

# Figure 5

## Figure 5A

```{r}
# 1. Define factor levels
treatment_levels <- c(
  "INSTI + Other",
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "Untreated",
  "Other + Abacavir",
  "Other + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Abacavir"
)

Subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)

# 2. Summarize Treatment by Subgroup
treatment_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace missing treatments with "Other + Other" placeholder
    Treatment = ifelse(is.na(Treatment), "Other + Other", Treatment),
    
    # Elite controllers are always considered untreated
    Treatment = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    ),
    
    # Recode any treatments not in the predefined levels as "Other + Other"
    Treatment = ifelse(!Treatment %in% treatment_levels, "Other + Other", Treatment),
    
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = Subgroup_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Treatment, Subgroup)

# 3. Stacked barplot: Treatment on y-axis, colored by Subgroup
ggplot(treatment_summary, aes(y = Treatment, x = n, fill = Subgroup)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Primary HIV infection" = "#1b9e77",
      "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
      "Elite controller" = "#7570b3",
      "Severely impaired immunity" = "#e7298a"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
                     name = "Number of individuals") +
  labs(
    title = "Subgroup distribution by treatment combination",
    y = "Treatment combination",
    fill = "Subgroup"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  theme_hiv()

# 4. Save outputs
ggsave("../plots/pdf/bar/stacked_bar_treatment_combinations.pdf", width = 14, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/bar/stacked_bar_treatment_combinations.png", width = 14, height = 7)
```

## Figure 5B

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 0. Define treatment levels
# ---------------------------
treatment_levels <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "Untreated",
  "Other"
)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Compute Δ CD4/CD8 and harmonise treatments
# ---------------------------
cd4_cd8_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  mutate(
    delta_CD4CD8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,

    # Handle missing treatment
    Treatment = if_else(is.na(Treatment), "Other", Treatment),

    # Elite controllers are untreated
    Treatment = if_else(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller",
      "Untreated",
      Treatment
    ),

    # Collapse everything else into "Other"
    Treatment = if_else(
      Treatment %in% treatment_levels,
      Treatment,
      "Other"
    ),

    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(delta_CD4CD8, Treatment) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Sample counts per Treatment × Subgroup
# ---------------------------
n_labels <- cd4_cd8_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Subgroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    y_pos = max(delta_CD4CD8, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

# ---------------------------
# 3. Plot
# ---------------------------
p_cd4 <- ggplot(
  cd4_cd8_df,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    y = delta_CD4CD8,
    fill = Subgroup
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = interaction(Treatment, Subgroup)),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(
      color = Subgroup,
      group = interaction(Treatment, Subgroup)
    ),
    dodge.width = 0.8,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = y_pos + 0.05,
      label = label,
      color = Subgroup,
      group = Subgroup
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 3.8,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Primary HIV infection" = "#1b9e77",
      "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
      "Elite controller" = "#7570b3",
      "Severely impaired immunity" = "#e7298a"
    )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Primary HIV infection" = "#1b9e77",
      "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
      "Elite controller" = "#7570b3",
      "Severely impaired immunity" = "#e7298a"
    )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in CD4/CD8 ratio by treatment and HIV Subgroup",
    subtitle = "Elite controllers included in the Untreated group",
    y = expression(Delta * " CD4/CD8 ratio"),
    x = "Treatment",
    fill = "Subgroup",
    color = "Subgroup"
  ) +
  theme_hiv()

print(p_cd4)

# ---------------------------
# 4. Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave("../plots/pdf/boxplot/cd4_cd8_change_by_treatment_untreated.pdf", width = 16, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/boxplot/cd4_cd8_change_by_treatment_untreated.png", width = 16, height = 7)
```

### CD4 T-cell count change

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ==================================================
# 1. Define treatment levels
# ==================================================

treatment_levels <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "Untreated",
  "Other"
)

# ==================================================
# 2. Compute Δ CD4 T-cell count
# ==================================================

cd4_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  mutate(
    # 🔥 CHANGE HERE
    delta_CD4 =
      `CD4 cell count (follow-up)` -
      `CD4 cell count (baseline)`,

    # Handle missing treatment
    Treatment = if_else(is.na(Treatment), "Other", Treatment),

    # Elite controllers are untreated
    Treatment = if_else(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller",
      "Untreated",
      Treatment
    ),

    # Collapse others
    Treatment = if_else(
      Treatment %in% treatment_levels,
      Treatment,
      "Other"
    ),

    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(delta_CD4, Treatment) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ==================================================
# 3. Sample counts per Treatment × Subgroup
# ==================================================

n_labels <- cd4_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Subgroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    y_pos = max(delta_CD4, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

# ==================================================
# 4. Plot
# ==================================================

p_cd4 <- ggplot(
  cd4_df,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    y = delta_CD4,
    fill = Subgroup
  )
) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = interaction(Treatment, Subgroup)),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(
      color = Subgroup,
      group = interaction(Treatment, Subgroup)
    ),
    dodge.width = 0.8,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = y_pos + 20,  # 🔥 adjust for CD4 scale
      label = label,
      color = Subgroup,
      group = Subgroup
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 3.8,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Primary HIV infection" = "#1b9e77",
    "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
    "Elite controller" = "#7570b3",
    "Severely impaired immunity" = "#e7298a"
  )) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Primary HIV infection" = "#1b9e77",
    "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
    "Elite controller" = "#7570b3",
    "Severely impaired immunity" = "#e7298a"
  )) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Change in CD4 T-cell count by treatment and HIV subgroup",
    subtitle = "Elite controllers included in the Untreated group",
    y = expression(Delta * " CD4 T-cell count (cells/"*mu*"L)"),
    x = "Treatment",
    fill = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    color = "HIV-1 subgroup"
  ) +
  
  theme_hiv()

p_cd4

# ==================================================
# 5. Save
# ==================================================

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/boxplot/cd4_change_by_treatment.pdf",
  p_cd4,
  width = 16,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/boxplot/cd4_change_by_treatment.png",
  p_cd4,
  width = 16,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Figure 5C

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller")

input_df <- data_wide_ml |> 
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}
pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Define treatment panels
# ---------------------------
treatment_panels <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare PCA plotting data
# ---------------------------
plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(input_metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Facet_group = Treatment
  ) |>
  # keep treatments of interest + Healthy
  filter(
    Treatment %in% treatment_panels |
      Subgroup == "Healthy"
  )

# ---------------------------
# Duplicate Healthy into all treatment panes
# ---------------------------
healthy_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Healthy") |>
  select(-Facet_group) |>
  expand_grid(Facet_group = treatment_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Healthy") |>
  bind_rows(healthy_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = treatment_panels)

# ---------------------------
# PCA variance
# ---------------------------
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_pca_treatment_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # ---- Filled ellipses by Timepoint (per facet) ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.2,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # ---- Dashed ellipse outlines ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype  = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # ---- Paired baseline → follow-up lines (HIV only) ----
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      filter(
        Subgroup != "Healthy",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey80",
    alpha  = 0.5
  ) +

  # ---- Points ----
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint, shape = Timepoint),
    size  = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 3) +

  # ---- Reference axes ----
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +

  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Timepoint",
    fill  = "Timepoint",
    shape = "Timepoint"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # Legend on top
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_pca_treatment_timepoint + coord_equal()

ggsave(filename = "pca_treatment_timepoint_facets_hiv_healthy.pdf", path = "../plots/pdf/pca/", width = 14, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = "pca_treatment_timepoint_facets_hiv_healthy.png", path = "../plots/png/pca/", width = 14, height = 10)
```

## Figure 5D

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Treatment %in% "INSTI + Abacavir") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma_paired(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Timepoint", 
                          case = "FU", 
                          control = "Baseline", 
                          correct = c("Subgroup"),
                          paired = TRUE,
                          id_column = "ID") |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 5,
                  top_down_prot = 10,
                  title = "INSTI + Abacavir: follow-up vs. baseline",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_instiaa_fu_baseline <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_instiaa_fu_baseline <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot insti fu baseline.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot insti fu baseline.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

## Figure 5G

```{r}
venn_sets <- list(
  "INSTI + Abacavir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_baseline |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  "INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_baseline |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  "NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_nnrtite_fu_baseline |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature)
)

# Ensure uniqueness
venn_sets <- lapply(venn_sets, unique)

# Sanity check: number of proteins per set
sapply(venn_sets, length)

# Inspect contents if needed
venn_sets

venn_colors <- c("#4B988F", "#C89A1B", "#EABBBB")

library(ggvenn)

p_venn <- ggvenn(
  venn_sets,
  fill_color   = venn_colors,
  fill_alpha   = 0.6,
  stroke_size  = 0.8,
  set_name_size = 5,
  text_size     = 4,
  show_elements = FALSE
) +
  ggtitle(
    "Overlap of differentially abundant proteins\n(Follow-up vs Baseline by treatment)"
  )

p_venn

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/venn_fu_baseline_treatments.pdf",
  plot   = p_venn,
  width  = 8,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/overlap/venn_fu_baseline_treatments.png",
  plot   = p_venn,
  width  = 8,
  height = 8,
  dpi    = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(writexl)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Print all overlap categories
# --------------------------------------------------

insti_ab <- venn_sets[["INSTI + Abacavir"]]
insti_te <- venn_sets[["INSTI + Tenofovir"]]
nnrti_te <- venn_sets[["NNRTI + Tenofovir"]]

overlap_all_three <- Reduce(intersect, venn_sets)

overlap_insti_ab_insti_te_only <- setdiff(
  intersect(insti_ab, insti_te),
  nnrti_te
)

overlap_insti_ab_nnrti_te_only <- setdiff(
  intersect(insti_ab, nnrti_te),
  insti_te
)

overlap_insti_te_nnrti_te_only <- setdiff(
  intersect(insti_te, nnrti_te),
  insti_ab
)

insti_ab_only <- setdiff(
  insti_ab,
  union(insti_te, nnrti_te)
)

insti_te_only <- setdiff(
  insti_te,
  union(insti_ab, nnrti_te)
)

nnrti_te_only <- setdiff(
  nnrti_te,
  union(insti_ab, insti_te)
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Print counts
# --------------------------------------------------

overlap_counts <- tibble(
  Overlap = c(
    "INSTI + Abacavir only",
    "INSTI + Tenofovir only",
    "NNRTI + Tenofovir only",
    "INSTI + Abacavir ∩ INSTI + Tenofovir only",
    "INSTI + Abacavir ∩ NNRTI + Tenofovir only",
    "INSTI + Tenofovir ∩ NNRTI + Tenofovir only",
    "All three"
  ),
  n = c(
    length(insti_ab_only),
    length(insti_te_only),
    length(nnrti_te_only),
    length(overlap_insti_ab_insti_te_only),
    length(overlap_insti_ab_nnrti_te_only),
    length(overlap_insti_te_nnrti_te_only),
    length(overlap_all_three)
  )
)

overlap_counts

# --------------------------------------------------
# Print protein names
# --------------------------------------------------

overlap_list <- list(
  "INSTI + Abacavir only" = insti_ab_only,
  "INSTI + Tenofovir only" = insti_te_only,
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir only" = nnrti_te_only,
  "INSTI + Abacavir and INSTI + Tenofovir only" = overlap_insti_ab_insti_te_only,
  "INSTI + Abacavir and NNRTI + Tenofovir only" = overlap_insti_ab_nnrti_te_only,
  "INSTI + Tenofovir and NNRTI + Tenofovir only" = overlap_insti_te_nnrti_te_only,
  "All three" = overlap_all_three
)

overlap_list
```
```{r}
overlap_excel <- lapply(overlap_list, function(x) {
  tibble(Feature = x)
})

write_xlsx(
  c(
    list("Counts" = overlap_counts),
    overlap_excel
  ),
  "../tables/overlap/venn_fu_baseline_treatments_overlaps.xlsx"
)
```

### Alternative

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define sets
# --------------------------------------------------

venn_sets <- list(
  "INSTI + Abacavir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature),

  "INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature),

  "NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_nnrtite_fu_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature)
)

venn_sets <- lapply(venn_sets, unique)

# Sanity check
sapply(venn_sets, length)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit Euler/Venn diagram
# --------------------------------------------------

venn_fit <- euler(venn_sets)

venn_colors <- c("#4B988F", "#C89A1B", "#EABBBB")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Save as PDF
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/overlap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/venn_fu_baseline_treatments.pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

plot(
  venn_fit,
  fills = list(
    fill = venn_colors,
    alpha = 0.6
  ),
  edges = list(
    col = "black",
    lwd = 1
  ),
  labels = list(
    fontsize = 14
  ),
  quantities = list(
    fontsize = 13
  )
)

dev.off()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save as PNG
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/png/overlap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

png(
  "../plots/png/overlap/venn_fu_baseline_treatments.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

plot(
  venn_fit,
  fills = list(
    fill = venn_colors,
    alpha = 0.6
  ),
  edges = list(
    col = "black",
    lwd = 1
  ),
  labels = list(
    fontsize = 14
  ),
  quantities = list(
    fontsize = 13
  )
)

dev.off()
```

## Figure 5H

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Treatment %in% c("INSTI + Abacavir", "INSTI + Tenofovir") & Timepoint == "Follow-up") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (follow-up)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (follow-up)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint)) |>
  mutate(Comparison = case_when(Treatment == "INSTI + Abacavir" ~ "case",
                                    TRUE ~ "control"))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Comparison", 
                          case = "case", 
                          control = "control", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")
                          ) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "INSTI + Abacavir (follow-up) vs. INSTI + Tenofovir (follow-up)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_instiaa_fu_instite <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_instiaa_fu_instite <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot insti ab fu te.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot insti av fu te.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

## Figure 5K

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ---------------------------
# Proteins of interest
# ---------------------------
highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "CPA2", "GSTA1", "ACY1", "DCXR", "ADH4", "RBP2"
)

# ---------------------------
# Treatments of interest
# ---------------------------
treatment_order <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"
)

# ---------------------------
# Colors (cohort-level)
# ---------------------------
group_colors <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir"  = "#D55E00",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir"  = "#0072B2",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"   = "#CC79A7",
  "Healthy"            = "#71BF6E",
  "Cardiovascular"     = "#FC8D62",
  "Metabolic"          = "#E5C494",
  "Elite controller"   = "#009E73"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ---------------------------
p_up <- data_long |>
  select(DAid, Feature, NPX) |>
  inner_join(
    metadata,
    by = "DAid"
  ) |>
  filter(
    Feature %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Treatment %in% treatment_order |
      Subgroup %in% c(
        "Healthy",
        "Cardiovascular",
        "Metabolic",
        "Elite controller"
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = highlighted_proteins),

    # -----------------------
    # X-axis grouping logic
    # -----------------------
    Group_time = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Healthy"          ~ "Healthy",
      Subgroup == "Cardiovascular"   ~ "Cardiovascular",
      Subgroup == "Metabolic"        ~ "Metabolic",
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Elite controller",
      TRUE ~ paste(Treatment, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
    ),

    # For consistent coloring
    Group_color = case_when(
      Subgroup %in% c(
        "Healthy",
        "Cardiovascular",
        "Metabolic",
        "Elite controller"
      ) ~ Subgroup,
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Explicit x-axis order
# ---------------------------
x_order <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Follow-up",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic",
  "Elite controller"
)

p_up$Group_time <- factor(p_up$Group_time, levels = x_order)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Group_time,
    y     = NPX,
    group = Group_time
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = Group_color),
    alpha  = 0.7,
    width  = 0.25,
    stroke = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Group_color),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Abundance of proteins significantly altered in Tenofovir treatment",
    x = "Treatment / Reference group",
    y = "NPX"
  )

print(p_up_plot)

# ---------------------------
# Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_treatment_selected.pdf",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 14
)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_treatment_selected.png",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 14
)
```

```{r}
    )
  )

    width  = 0.25,

  ) +

    aes(fill = Group_color),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Differential proteins TDF vs. TAF",
    x = "Specific backbone 2 / Reference group",
    y = "NPX"
  )

print(p_up_plot)

# ---------------------------
# Save
# ---------------------------

  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_by_2nd_backbone.pdf",

  width    = 5,

)
```

### Alternative

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

set.seed(12345)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Settings
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Put all DE result dataframes into a named list
# --------------------------------------------------

de_list <- list(
  "INSTI + Abacavir vs INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_instite,

  "INSTI + Abacavir vs NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_nnrtite,

  "INSTI + Tenofovir vs NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_nnrtite,

  "TDF vs TAF" =
    res_tdf_fu_taf,

  "TDF vs Abacavir" =
    res_tdf_fu_abacavir
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Convert DE results to long edge table
# --------------------------------------------------

cnet_edges <- imap_dfr(de_list, function(df, comparison_name) {

  df |>
    filter(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = comparison_name,
      Direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~ "Increased",
        logFC < 0 ~ "Decreased"
      ),
      abs_logFC = abs(logFC)
    ) |>
    select(
      Comparison,
      Feature,
      logFC,
      abs_logFC,
      P.Value,
      adj.P.Val,
      Direction
    )
})

# Check number of significant protein-comparison links
cnet_edges |> count(Comparison, Direction)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create nodes
# --------------------------------------------------

comparison_nodes <- tibble(
  name = names(de_list),
  type = "Comparison"
)

protein_nodes <- cnet_edges |>
  count(Feature, name = "n_comparisons") |>
  transmute(
    name = Feature,
    type = "Protein",
    n_comparisons = n_comparisons
  )

nodes <- bind_rows(
  comparison_nodes,
  protein_nodes
) |>
  mutate(
    n_comparisons = ifelse(is.na(n_comparisons), 1, n_comparisons)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create graph object
# --------------------------------------------------

graph_edges <- cnet_edges |>
  transmute(
    from = Comparison,
    to   = Feature,
    logFC,
    abs_logFC,
    adj.P.Val,
    Direction
  )

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = graph_edges,
  vertices = nodes,
  directed = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot cnet-style network
# --------------------------------------------------

p_cnet <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +

  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      color = Direction,
      width = abs_logFC
    ),
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +

  geom_node_point(
    aes(
      shape = type,
      size = ifelse(type == "Protein", n_comparisons, 5)
    ),
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  scale_edge_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Increased" = "#C03830",
      "Decreased" = "#317EC2"
    )
  ) +

  scale_edge_width(
    range = c(0.4, 2.2),
    name = "|logFC|"
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Comparison" = 22,
      "Protein" = 21
    )
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 8),
    name = "Number of comparisons"
  ) +

  labs(
    edge_color = "Direction",
    shape = NULL
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_cnet

dir.create("../plots/pdf/network", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/network", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/network/cnet_treatment_comparisons.pdf",
  p_cnet,
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/network/cnet_treatment_comparisons.png",
  p_cnet,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Heatmap version

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(12345)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Settings
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. DE list
# --------------------------------------------------

de_list <- list(
  "INSTI + Abacavir vs INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_instite,

  "INSTI + Abacavir vs NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_nnrtite,

  "INSTI + Tenofovir vs NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_nnrtite,
  
  "Tenofovir (TDF + TAF) vs Abacavir" =
    res_te_fu_abacavir,

  "TDF vs TAF" =
    res_tdf_fu_taf,

  "TDF vs Abacavir" =
    res_tdf_fu_abacavir
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Combine all DE results
# --------------------------------------------------

df_all <- imap_dfr(de_list, function(df, comparison_name) {
  
  df |>
    mutate(Comparison = comparison_name) |>
    select(Comparison, Feature, logFC, adj.P.Val)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Keep ONLY significant proteins (per comparison)
# --------------------------------------------------

df_sig <- df_all |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Get union of significant proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

sig_features <- unique(df_sig$Feature)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create full matrix (important for consistent layout)
# --------------------------------------------------

df_plot <- df_all |>
  filter(Feature %in% sig_features) |>
  mutate(
    logFC_plot = ifelse(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff,
      logFC,
      NA
    ),
    size_plot = ifelse(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      -log10(adj.P.Val),
      NA
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Order proteins (by strongest signal)
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_order <- df_plot |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(max_fc = max(abs(logFC_plot), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(max_fc)) |>
  pull(Feature)

df_plot <- df_plot |>
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = feature_order))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Bubble plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_bubble <- ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(
    x = Comparison,
    y = Feature
  )
) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = size_plot,
      fill = logFC_plot
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#317EC2",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#C03830",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "logFC"
  ) +
  
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = expression(-log[10]("adj.P.Val")),
    range = c(2, 8)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Differential proteins across treatment comparisons (at follow-up)",
    x = "Comparison",
    y = "Protein"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_bubble

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/bubble", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/bubble", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bubble/treatment_comparison_bubble.pdf",
  p_bubble,
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bubble/treatment_comparison_bubble.png",
  p_bubble,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# 1. Define ART category levels
art_levels <- c("Untreated", "INSTI", "NNRTI", "PI", "Other treatment")

# 2. Summarize ART status per Subgroup
art_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # If ART is NA and not Elite controller, label as "Untreated"
  mutate(
    ART = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      is.na(ART)                       ~ "Other treatment",
      TRUE                             ~ ART
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(ART, levels = art_levels)) %>%
  count(Subgroup, status)

# 3. Stacked barplot: Subgroup on x, counts on y, fill by ART status
ggplot(art_summary, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color    = "black",
            size     = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("INSTI"     = "#E78AC3",
               "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
               "NNRTI"     = "#A6D854",
               "PI"        = "#66C2A5",
               "Other treatment" = "#FFD92F")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
                     name   = "Number of individuals") +
  labs(
    title = "ART Status by Subgroup",
    x     = "Subgroup",
    fill  = "ART status"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
# 1. Define backbone levels (optional ordering)
backbone_levels <- c("Untreated", "Tenofovir", "Abacavir", "Other treatment")

  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    `Backbone 2` = ifelse(is.na(`Backbone 2`), "Other", `Backbone 2`),

  mutate(

      TRUE                             ~ as.character(backbone_group)

  # If NA then Other treatment
  mutate(
    backbone_group = replace_na(backbone_group, "Other treatment")
```

```{r}
    values = c(
```

```{r}
      "INSTI + Tenofovir"    = "#80B1D3",
      "INSTI + Abacavir"     = "#FDB462",
      "NNRTI + Tenofovir"    = "#B3DE69",
      "PI"                   = "#FB8072",
      "Other treatment"      = "#FFD92F"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment by Subgroup",
    x = "Subgroup",
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_treatment

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/bar", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/bar", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bar/stacked_bar_treatment.pdf",
  p_treatment,
  width = 12,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bar/stacked_bar_treatment.png",
  p_treatment,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Combining S14A-S14D

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define consistent subgroup order
# --------------------------------------------------

subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. ART STATUS
# --------------------------------------------------

art_levels <- c("Untreated", "INSTI", "NNRTI", "PI", "Other treatment")

art_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    ART = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      is.na(ART) ~ "Other treatment",
      TRUE ~ ART
    ),
    status = factor(ART, levels = art_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, status, .drop = FALSE)

p_art <- ggplot(art_summary, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "INSTI" = "#E78AC3",
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "NNRTI" = "#A6D854",
    "PI" = "#FB8072",
    "Other treatment" = "#FFD92F"
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "ART status", x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_hiv()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. BACKBONE
# --------------------------------------------------

backbone_levels <- c("Untreated", "Tenofovir", "Abacavir", "Other treatment")

backbone_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    backbone_group = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ "Other treatment",
      TRUE ~ `Backbone 2`
    ),
    backbone_group = factor(backbone_group, levels = backbone_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, backbone_group, .drop = FALSE)

p_backbone <- ggplot(backbone_summary, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = backbone_group)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Tenofovir" = "#80B1D3",
    "Abacavir" = "#FDB462",
    "Other treatment" = "#FFD92F",
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494"
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Backbone 2", x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_hiv()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. SPECIFIC BACKBONE
# --------------------------------------------------

specific_levels <- c("Untreated", "TDF", "TAF", "Abacavir", "Other treatment")

specific_summary <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    backbone_group = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      `Specific backbone 2` %in% c("TDF", "TAF", "Abacavir") ~ `Specific backbone 2`,
      TRUE ~ "Other treatment"
    ),
    backbone_group = factor(backbone_group, levels = specific_levels)
  ) |>
  count(Subgroup, backbone_group, .drop = FALSE)

p_specific <- ggplot(specific_summary, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = backbone_group)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "TDF" = "#80B1D3",
    "TAF" = "#4F8FC0",
    "Abacavir" = "#FDB462",
    "Other treatment" = "#FFD92F"
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Specific backbone", x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_hiv()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. TREATMENT
# --------------------------------------------------

treatment_levels <- c(
  "Untreated",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "PI",
  "Other treatment"
)

treatment_summary <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    treatment_group = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      Treatment %in% treatment_levels ~ Treatment,
      TRUE ~ "Other treatment"
    ),
    treatment_group = factor(treatment_group, levels = treatment_levels)
  ) |>
  count(Subgroup, treatment_group, .drop = FALSE)

p_treatment <- ggplot(treatment_summary, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = treatment_group)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "INSTI + Tenofovir" = "#80B1D3",
    "INSTI + Abacavir" = "#FDB462",
    "NNRTI + Tenofovir" = "#B3DE69",
    "PI" = "#FB8072",
    "Other treatment" = "#FFD92F"
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Treatment", x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_hiv()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. COMBINE WITH PATCHWORK
# --------------------------------------------------

final_plot <-
  (p_art | p_backbone) /
  (p_specific | p_treatment) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_plot

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. SAVE
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/bar", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/bar", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bar/combined_treatment_overview.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bar/combined_treatment_overview.png",
  final_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#### Alternative

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Subgroup order
# --------------------------------------------------

subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Primary HIV-1 infection",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# COMMON THEME (🔥 key improvement)
# --------------------------------------------------

theme_panel <- function(title_text) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_blank(),

      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),

      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# GENERIC FUNCTION (🔥 avoids repetition)
# --------------------------------------------------

make_plot <- function(df, fill_var, fill_colors, strip_title) {
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = .data[[fill_var]])) +
    
    geom_col(
      color = "white",
      width = 0.6   # 🔥 thinner bars
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    
    coord_flip() +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    
    facet_wrap(~1, labeller = labeller(. = strip_title)) +
    
    labs(y = "Count") +
    
    theme_panel()
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. ART STATUS (A)
# --------------------------------------------------

art_levels <- c("Untreated", "INSTI", "NNRTI", "PI")

art_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    ART = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ ART
    ),
    ART = factor(ART, levels = art_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, ART, .drop = FALSE)

p_art <- make_plot(
  art_summary,
  "ART",
  c(
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "INSTI" = "#CC79A7",
    "NNRTI" = "#7CAE00",
    "PI" = "#F8766D"
  ),
  strip_title = function(x) "ART status"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. BACKBONE 2 (B)
# --------------------------------------------------

backbone_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    backbone = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ `Backbone 2`
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, backbone, .drop = FALSE)

p_backbone <- make_plot(
  backbone_summary,
  "backbone",
  c(
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "Tenofovir" = "#80B1D3",
    "Abacavir" = "#FDB462"
  ),
  strip_title = function(x) "2nd Backbone"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. SPECIFIC BACKBONE (C)
# --------------------------------------------------

specific_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    backbone = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ `Specific backbone 2`
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, backbone, .drop = FALSE)

p_specific <- make_plot(
  specific_summary,
  "backbone",
  c(
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "TDF" = "#80B1D3",
    "TAF" = "#4F8FC0",
    "Abacavir" = "#FDB462"
  ),
  strip_title = function(x) "Specific backbone"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. TREATMENT (D)
# --------------------------------------------------

treatment_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    treatment = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, treatment, .drop = FALSE)

p_treatment <- make_plot(
  treatment_summary,
  "treatment",
  c(
    "Untreated" = "#E5C494",
    "INSTI + Tenofovir" = "#80B1D3",
    "INSTI + Abacavir" = "#FDB462",
    "NNRTI + Tenofovir" = "#B3DE69",
    "PI" = "#FB8072"
  ),
  strip_title = function(x) "Treatment combination"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. COMBINE (🔥 layout matches your figure)
# --------------------------------------------------

final_plot <-
  (p_art | p_backbone) /
  (p_specific | p_treatment) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_plot

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. SAVE (landscape like your figure)
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bar/supplementary_figure14_style.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bar/supplementary_figure14_style.png",
  final_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```
